name: Aachen Chapel
description:
Inspires units in a large radius so long as a Prelate is garrisoned.
Acts as a drop-off point for all resource types.

name: Abbey of Kings
description: Heals all nearby friendly units that are out of combat by +6 every 1 seconds. May also Crown a King, a powerful cavalry leader with a healing aura. Queues production of a free King upon completion.

name: Aqueduct
description: Stone infrastructure to connect water between Cisterns to improve the Water Level of all connected Cisterns. Can be connected to Stone Walls.

name: Barbican of the Sun
description:
Fires a long range hand cannon and adds arrowslits while garrisoned. Can be upgraded with weaponry and offers vision into Stealth Forests. 
Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Barracks
description: Produces melee infantry units.

name: Capital Town Center
description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.
Capital Town Centers can detect units stealth or disguises.

name: Chamber of Commerce
description: Acts as a Market. Trains one free Trader for each economic technology researched.

name: Cistern
description:
Improves the gather rate of nearby villagers by +10/14/18/22/26% depending on network level. Generates influence that boosts production, research or defense. Can activate Arkitoi Defense to briefly arm nearby Villagers. 
Connect Cisterns with Aqueducts to enhance their influence and villager gather rate aura.

name: Council Hall
description:
Acts as an Archery Range with all units and technologies. Works +100% faster.
Longbowmen produced from this landmark are -5% cheaper.

name: Deer Stones
description:
Deer Stones grant access to the Khan's Hunter at the Archery Range.
Instantly researches the Yam Network technology.

name: Dock
description:
Produces naval units.
Automatically repairs nearby damaged naval units.
Capable of holding up to three Fishing Ships.

name: Dome of the Faith
description: Acts as a Mosque. Produce Scholars at a discount of 55 Gold.

name: Farm
description:
Harvestable Food source. Use a Villager to gather Food from the Farm.
Only one Villager can work each Farm.

name: Farmhouse
description: Increases your maximum Population and Villagers can drop-off Food at this building. Contains technologies to improve Food gathering.

name: Flower Pagoda
description:
Grants the ability to plant a Flower Garden which improves the gather rate of Villagers and the attack speed of non-siege military units as long as they are in the Flower Garden.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Forge
description: Villagers can drop-off Stone and Gold at this building. Houses technologies to improve mining and military units.

name: Fortified Outpost
description: Offers extensive line of sight and detects units stealth or disguises. Can be upgraded with weaponry and fortifications. Attacks while garrisoned.

name: Fortified Palisade Gate
description: Relatively sturdy defensive gate. Must be built on a Fortified Palisade Wall segment.

name: Fortified Palisade Wall
description: Well-built defensive wall for quickly fortifying an area.

name: Ger
description:
Villagers can drop off Food, Wood, and Gold at this building. Houses technologies to improve resource gathering.
Stone is gathered through Ovoos.

name: Golden Tent
description:
Contains upgrades that will advance through the Ages. Batu Khan and his Torguud can be deployed to the field.
Can activate Edicts which will change the bonuses provided by Fortified Outposts.

name: Granary
description:
Villagers can drop off Food at this building. Improves the Farm gather rate of nearby Villagers by +10% (stacks with other Granaries). Generates tax each time a resource is dropped off.
A maximum of 3 Granaries can be constructed.

name: Grand Winery
description: Acts as a Mill and Monastery. Nearby Villagers gather +60% Olive Oil from Berry Bushes and Olive Groves. Relics garrisoned generate Olive Oil instead of Gold.

name: Great Pasture
description:
Acts as a War Stable and Grassland.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Harbor
description:
Strong Dock that produces naval units and increases the health of nearby ships.
Automatically repairs nearby damaged naval units.
Capable of holding up to 4 Fishing Ships.

name: House
description: Increases your maximum Population.

name: House of Wisdom
description:
Contains civilization technology for the Abbasid Dynasty.
Abbasids advance in Ages through the House of Wisdom. Construct wings to advance to the next Age and gain additional technology.

name: Hunting Cabin
description:
Villagers can drop off Food at this building. It houses technologies to improve Food gathering and produces Scouts.
Generates Gold based on the number of nearby trees. Trees in overlapped areas are only counted once.

name: Imperial Academy
description: Nearby buildings generate 100% more Gold from taxes. Imperial Officials produced here cost 30% less resources and can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Imperial Hippodrome
description:
Acts as a Stable. Contains the Triumph ability that can be activated with Supply Points to increase cavalry melee damage, move speed, and health regeneration. 
Comes with 10 Supply Points and generates one every 25 seconds. Earn more points by defeating enemy units.

name: Jiangnan Tower
description:
Acts as a tax drop-off for Imperial Officials.
Military Buildings and Military Units produced within influence award progress towards free armies. Each free army requires progressively more resources to be spent than the last, until 12 armies have been produced.

name: Koka Township
description: Can produce Shinobi espionage units which specialize in scouting, sabotage, and assassination. Queues production of a free Shinobi upon completion.

name: Kremlin
description:
Acts as a Wooden Fortress that comes with Arrowslits, Castle Turret, and Castle Watch technologies.
Can Levy Militia every 80 seconds to the Capital Town Center. The number of Militia levied increases upon reaching the Castle Age.

name: Kura Storehouse
description: Universal drop-off location that creates a Farm around the Landmark every 50 seconds — generates Wood instead when farmland becomes full.

name: Lancaster Castle
description:
Defensive Landmark that can do a one-time muster of units in each Age. The cost of mustering units is reduced by 50 resources per Manor.
Grants all Manors +500 health and an arrowslit emplacement.

name: Lumber Camp
description: Villagers can drop off Wood at this building. Houses technologies to improve Wood gathering.

name: Mansa Quarry
description: Generates 75 Gold per minute. Can be toggled to generate Stone instead.

name: Matsuri
description:
The Matsuri acts as a early Market and universal drop-off location.
 
Produces the Yatai. The Yatai can gather Food and when full it will send a trader back to the Matsuri, which improves the Matsuri gather rate aura by +5%.

name: Meditation Gardens
description:
Increases the resource value of nearby gold veins, stone outcroppings, and berry bushes by +5% every 30 seconds up to a maximum of +60%.
Trees are increased at a lesser rate of +2.5% up to +30%.
After 330 seconds, generates resources equal to 5% of the current resources in those nearby deposits. Additionally generates 5% of the maximum resources of each deposit when fully gathered.

name: Meinwerk Palace
description: Acts like a Blacksmith. Technology researched here costs -50% and researches 50% faster. Contains Technologies unique to this Landmark.

name: Military School
description: The Military School can be assigned to produce one type of unit continuously at no cost, however they are produced at a slower rate.

name: Mill
description:
Villagers can drop off Food at this building. Houses technologies to improve Food gathering.
Constructing the Mill near Berry Bushes increases the amount of Food available by +100.

name: Mining Camp
description: Villagers can drop off Stone and Gold at this building. Houses technologies to improve mining.

name: Mosque
description: Produces religious units and houses religious technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

name: Olive Grove
description:
Harvestable Food source. Use a Villager to gather Food from the Olive Grove.
Only one Villager can work each Olive Grove.
Byzantine Villagers gather Olive Oil equal to 20% of Food gathered.

name: Outpost
description: Offers extensive line of sight and detects units stealth or disguises. Can be upgraded with weaponry and fortifications. Attacks while garrisoned.

name: Ovoo
description:
Must be built on a Stone Outcropping.
Harvests 60 Stone per minute even from Depleted Stone Deposits. Build limit is increased by +1 after each age up.

name: Pagoda
description:
Religious units can pick up Relics and place them in the Pagoda to generate +100 Gold, +62 Food, +62 Wood, and +25 Stone every 60 seconds.
A maximum of 3 Pagodas can be constructed.

name: Palisade
description: Light defensive wall for quickly fortifying an area.

name: Palisade Gate
description: Light defensive gate. Must be built on a Palisade Wall segment.

name: Pasture
description: Automatically produces a gatherable Sheep every 140 seconds. Will eventually stop producing if too many Sheep are produced and not gathered.

name: Pit Mine
description:
Must be built on a Gold Vein.
Mines 36 Gold per minute without depleting the deposit. If a deposit has been depleted, the Pit Mine can be re-placed on exhausted Gold Veins.

name: Relic Ovoo
description:
The Relic Ovoo does not have to be placed on Stone deposits and the Relic will drop if the Ovoo is destroyed.
Harvests 60 Stone per minute.

name: Runestones
description: Carve a Runestone after defeating 5 military units to celebrate honorable victories in combat, enhancing Varangian ranged weapons by 1 tile, melee damage by 1, and move speed by 15%. Lasts 150 seconds.

name: Ryokan
description: Increases Population by +60 and nearby units get a permanent healing buff, healing 4 every 5 seconds when out of combat.

name: Saharan Trade Network
description:
Acts as a Toll Outpost that comes with Defensive Javelin Emplacement researched. Unlocks Javelin Emplacement for Outposts.
All Traders and Trade Ships taxed will generate Food equal to the taxed Gold at this Landmark. All other Toll Outposts will generate 50% of taxed Gold as Food.

name: School of Cavalry
description: Acts as a Stable. All of your stables produce units +20% faster.

name: Stable
description: Produces cavalry military units.

name: Stockyard
description:
Food drop off and harvestable Food source. Use a Villager to gather Food from the sheep carcasses.
Up to four Villagers can work each Stockyard.

name: Sultanhani Trade Network
description: Acts as a Market. Comes with 3 Traders garrisoned and generates +26 Gold per minute for each one. Up to 10 Traders can be garrisoned.

name: The Golden Gate
description: Allows the exchange of resources at a favorable rate. Generates an additional exchange every 50 seconds.

name: The Silver Tree
description: Acts as a Market. Production speed of Traders increased by +40% with a -40% reduced Gold cost.

name: Toll Outpost
description:
Offers extensive line of sight and detects units stealth or disguises. Can be upgraded with weaponry and fortifications. Attacks while garrisoned.
Passing Traders and Trade Ships instantly provide an additional 8% of their carried Gold. Does not generate any bonus tax if a toll outpost is built within range of another one.

name: Tower of Victory
description: Enables Tower of Victory, Mosques, and Madrasas to increase the attack speed of infantry by +20% when produced within their influence.

name: Town Center
description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.
Non-Capital Town Centers can't detect stealth or disguises.

name: Twin Minaret Medrese
description: Acts as a Mill. Grows 4 Berry Bushes which can be harvested +50% faster. Berry Bushes are regrown after 120 seconds if depleted.

name: Varangian Stronghold
description: Structure capable of producing any Varangian unit.

name: Varangian Warcamp
description:
Increases your maximum Population.
 
As the Empire suffers casualties in war, the emperor calls forth more Varangians. 
Once enough troops are lost in battle, the selected Varangian is reinforced to the battlefield at no cost. If placed on shore near water, Attack Ships or Galleys become available as reinforcements.
 
Reinforcements cost 6 times their value in fallen warriors.

name: Village
description:
Increases maximum Population by 40.
A maximum of 3 Villages can be constructed.

name: Wooden Fortress
description: Sturdy wooden stronghold with extensive line of sight that detects units stealth or disguises. Can be upgraded with weaponry. Attacks while garrisoned.

name: Worker Elephant
description:
Send a new Worker Elephant from the nearest Town Center or Tughlaqabad Fort to the targeted location. 
Villagers automatically gather resources once they reach the location.

name: Abbey of the Trinity
description: Acts as a Monastery. Reduces the cost of Warrior Monks by -50% and contains unique religious technologies.

name: Archery Range
description: Produces ranged infantry units.

name: Astronomical Clocktower
description: Acts as a Siege Workshop and produces siege engines with +50% health.

name: Blacksmith
description: Houses technology to improve infantry and cavalry.

name: Burgrave Palace
description:
Acts as a Barracks that produces 400% faster.
Infantry gains +50% charge damage.

name: Cattle Ranch
description: Cattle garrisoned in this ranch generate +25 Food per minute. This value is increased by the food upgrades.

name: Cistern of the First Hill
description:
Acts as a Cistern. Unlocks the Pilgrim Flask ability on non-siege military units, which can be activated to increase health regeneration by 25 per second for 6 seconds.
Flasks refill every 30 seconds to a maximum of 20 active flasks.

name: Compound of the Defender
description:
Infantry units can build Stone Walls, Gates, and Towers. Reduces Stone cost of buildings and their emplacements by 20%.
Contains defensive technologies that ignore building and Imperial Age (IV) requirements.

name: Dragon Pavilion
description:
Grants a free Meng'an Mouke Emplacement to all Town Centers and comes with a Meng'an Mouke Emplacement.
Trains Emissaries at a 33% discount and spawns 1 free Emissary upon completion.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Farimba Garrison
description: Enlist one of three units to enhance your roster for free: the Mansa Musofadi, Mansa Javelineer, or Freeborn Warrior. The other two can be enlisted for an additional cost.

name: Floating Gate
description:
Produces a Shinto Priest carrying a Yorishiro every 2 minutes. The first priest spawns instantly. Deposit up to 4 Yorishiro in buildings to provide unique bonuses.
 
Unlocks Shinto Shrines, which contains unique Shinto technologies and produces Shinto Priests.

name: Fortress
description:
Unique Landmark fortification for the Knights Templar, can be fully destroyed.
Has an aura that improves nearby units range.
Each Fortress increases the number of Pilgrims travelling.

name: Golden Horn Tower
description: Periodically produces unlocked Mercenary Units for free.

name: Grand Fulani Corral
description: Nearby cattle provide 18 Food per minute.

name: Grassland
description:
Must be constructed on a Grassland Post.
Spawns a Horse up to the max of 5 every 90/60/45 seconds in Feudal/Castle/Imperial Ages. Each Horse in a Grassland grants +2 maximum Health to all Melee Cavalry and +1 to all Ranged Cavalry.
Horses can be used by War Stables in Influence to instantly train Cavalry at a 25 resources discount.

name: Guild Hall
description: Generates and stores resources over time, the more resources stored the faster they are generated. Select between Food, Wood, Stone, or Gold. Generates stone at half the rate.

name: High Trade House
description:
Generates Gold like a Hunting Cabin with the value increased by +400%, without claiming any trees. Spawns a Huntable Deer every 60 seconds.
Villagers can drop off Food at this building.

name: Hojo Clan Daimyo Estate
description:
Increases Hojo Clan support providing bonuses to Barracks Infantry.  
Produces the Daimyo unit. Hojo Daimyo Estate health is increased +1000 and cost increased x2 Stone and Wood.

name: House of Learning
description: Grants no immediate bonus other than advancing to the next Age, but contains many unique technologies.

name: Imperial Palace
description:
A spy Landmark with 28 tile sight radius and the Imperial Spies ability. Activate to view location of enemy workers for 15 seconds.
Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Istanbul Imperial Palace
description: Doubles Imperial Council experience gained globally and increases the Vizier Point limit by +4.

name: King's College
description:
Reduces research costs of all technologies by -20%.
Contains unique Military technologies for House of Lancaster.

name: King's Palace
description: Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +10% faster.

name: Kurultai
description: Nearby units within its aura heal +1 health every 1 second and gain an additional +20% damage.

name: Machine Workshop
description:
Produces ranged infantry and siege engines.
Repairs nearby siege engines.

name: Manor
description:
Acts as a drop off building for all resource types. Passively generates 10 wood and 30 food per minute. Generates an additional 4 food and 2 wood for each nearby villager. 
Villagers only affect one Manor at a time.
Increases your maximum Population by +10.

name: Market
description: Allows the buying and selling of resources and produces the Trader.

name: Mehmed Imperial Armory
description: Produces siege engines for free but with a longer train time.

name: Mercenary House
description:
Produces Mercenary units for Olive Oil after purchasing a Mercenary Contract. One contract can be purchased.
Unlock another set of Mercenaries with +50% production speed by placing this building near a Trade Post.

name: Mount Lu Academy
description:
Imperial Officials collect tax twice as often and also collect 20% of taxes as Food.
Contains unique upgrades that greatly improve the Imperial Official unit.

name: Mountain Hall
description:
Acts as a Monastery and Monasteries are 50% cheaper.
Generate Karma by gathering resources near Monasteries. Losing units decreases Karma. At max Karma, receive the blessing of the Four Heavenly Kings for 60 seconds.
- Buildings regenerate 50 health per second.
- Villagers gather from Farms +75% faster.
- Relics generate +300% more gold.
- Defenses attack +50% faster.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Oda Clan Daimyo Estate
description:
Increases Oda Clan support providing bonuses to Archery Range Infantry.
Produces the Daimyo unit. Oda Daimyo Estate health is increased +1000 and cost increased x2 Stone and Wood.

name: Regnitz Cathedral
description: Acts as a Monastery. All Relics generate +100% gold while garrisoned.

name: Royal Institute
description: Houses all technologies unique to the French. Research is -30% cheaper here and ignores Age requirements.

name: Sake Brewery
description: The Brewery will create Toko-Koji Mats around itself which can be worked by Villagers to generate Gold. Villagers can drop-off Stone and Gold at this building.

name: Shaolin Monastery
description: Unique Monastery capable of producing Shaolin Monks. From the Yuan Dynasty onwards, Shaolin Monks can also be produced from Pagodas.

name: Steppe Redoubt
description: Acts as a Ger. Gold dropped off at this Landmark is increased by +50%.

name: Stone Wall
description:
Sturdy wall that cannot be attacked by torches. 
Units on walls take 25% less damage from ranged attacks, 50% less damage from siege attacks, and their range is increased by +1.

name: Stone Wall Gate
description:
Heavy defensive gate. Must be built on a Stone Wall segment.
Infantry can use the gate to access the top of the walls.

name: Stone Wall Tower
description:
Heavy defensive tower that fires a springald. Must be built on a Stone Wall segment.
Infantry can use the tower to access the top of the walls.

name: Takeda Clan Daimyo Estate
description:
Increases Takeda Clan support providing bonuses to Stables Cavalry.
Produces the Daimyo unit. Takeda Daimyo Estate health is increased +1000 and cost increased x2 Stone and Wood.

name: Temple of Equality
description:
Produces Buddhist Monks and contains unique Buddhist technologies. Buddhist Monks and Buddhist Temples provide support in combat by decreasing enemy damage with Sohei's Sutra. Buddhist monks enhance the damage of nearby units when using Buddhist Conversion.
 
Also allows construction of 4 additional Buddhist Temples.

name: The White Tower
description: Acts as a Keep with all the behaviors, technologies, and bonuses. Works 75% faster.

name: Tughlaqabad Fort
description: Heavy garrison and defensible position that can select a Governor bonus. Can be upgraded with weaponry. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.

name: Varangian Arsenal
description: Houses advanced technology for the Macedonian Dynasty.

name: War Stable
description:
Produces melee and ranged cavalry units.
Traders can use the War Stable as their Home Market.

name: Berkshire Palace
description: Acts as a Keep with increased health and powerful incendiary arrows. All weapons have 14.5 tiles of range.

name: Buddhist Temple
description: Produces the Buddhist Monk and houses Unique Buddhist technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

name: Castle of the Crow
description: Acts as a Castle. Can periodically spawn Treasure Caravans from selected neutral Trading Posts to provide a large amount of Food, Wood, Gold, and some Stone when reaching the Castle of the Crow.

name: College of Artillery
description:
Produces the Royal Artillery versions of the Cannon, Ribauldequin, and Culverin, which do +30% more damage.
Unlocks the Artillery ability for all Cannons.
Contains Siege and Gunpowder Technologies, trains units and researches technologies 50% faster.

name: Elzbach Palace
description:
Acts as a Keep with +50% health. All buildings within influence take -25% less damage.
Can train 8 Black Riders per Keep instead of 5.

name: Foreign Engineering Company
description: Allows production of Nest of Bees, Huihui Pao, and Royal Cannons with Olive Oil. Mercenaries receive various unique technologies from their original civilization.

name: Fort of the Huntress
description:
Acts as a Keep that shoots poison arrows. Infantry units nearby the Landmark enter Stealth for 30 seconds.
Musofadi Warriors and Musofadi Gunners gain First Strike, dealing more damage when breaking Stealth with an attack.

name: Great Wall Bastion
description:
Acts as a Keep with 4 mounted Bed Crossbow weapons instead of regular emplacements.
Increases the damage of all Bed Crossbow projectiles by +3.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Great Wall Gatehouse
description:
Must be built over Stone Walls.
Comes with a Nest of Bees emplacement and provides +25% ranged damage to all units on walls.

name: Griot Bara
description: Begin a festival for 300 Gold, providing global enhancements to Food gather rates, unit production speeds, or damage of torches and siege attacks. One festival may be active at a time.

name: High Armory
description: Decrease the cost of siege engines in nearby Siege Workshops by -20%. Contains unique siege engine technologies.

name: Hisar Academy
description: Acts as Madrasa. Generates +12 Food per minute based on the number of technologies researched. Does not apply to emplacements.

name: Istanbul Observatory
description: Acts as a University. Improves the influence provided by the University and Blacksmith and production speed of the Grand Galley to +85%.

name: Keep
description: Heavy garrison and defensible position. Can be upgraded with weaponry. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.

name: Khaganate Palace
description: Automatically spawns diverse armies from across the Mongol Empire and its dominions.

name: Monastery
description: Produces religious units and houses religious technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

name: Pagoda Forest
description:
Spawns a Small Pagoda Forest nearby every 30 seconds up to a cap of 15. Each Small Pagoda Forest generates 20 Wood every 30 seconds and slows nearby enemy movement speed by 20%.
May garrison up to 3 Monks to cast a large cascading conversion, which grows larger for every Monk garrisoned.
Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.

name: Palace of Swabia
description:
Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +200% faster and at -66% cost.
Cost to build this Landmark is reduced by -10%.

name: Palace of the Sultan
description: Automatically produces Sultan's Elite Tower Elephants. Garrison up to 4 Scholars in the Landmark to increase production speed.

name: Palatine School
description: When training Limitanei, Varangian Guards, Cataphracts, or Cheirosiphons there is a 30% chance to also spawn one at this Landmark.

name: Prayer Tent
description: Produces religious units and houses religious technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

name: Red Palace
description:
Acts as a Keep. Features high-damage arbalest emplacements. Each garrisoned unit adds an additional arbalest.
Activates an Arbalest emplacement on all Keeps and Town Centers.

name: Sea Gate Castle
description:
Acts as a Keep with a free Great Bombard emplacement. Defensive Strucutures deal 20% more damage.
All Keeps gain an aura that increases Trader and Trade Ship movement speed by +30% and armor by +8.

name: Shinto Shrine
description: Produces the Shinto Priest and houses Unique Shinto technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

name: Siege Workshop
description: Produces siege engines and powerful gunpowder units.

name: Spasskaya Tower
description:
Acts as a Keep with all weapon emplacements and increased health.
Unlocks the building of Stone Walls, Stone Gates, and Stone Wall Towers.

name: Spirit Way
description:
Dynasty technology can be researched here for -50% cost and +150% research speed. When a dynasty unit is killed, nearby units receive +20% attack speed and +20 health over 10 seconds.
Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.

name: Sword Hunt Statue
description: Daimyo cost decreased by 50% and increases Daimyo Aura attack speed bonus +20%. Level 3 Daimyo Estates will spawn levies +100% faster.

name: Tanegashima Gunsmith
description: Stockpiles weapon supplies every 30 seconds that can be used to instantly produce gunpowder units - comes with 2 stockpiles. Produces Ozutsu, a unique heavy ranged gunpowder infantry with siege damage. Allows access to Ribauldequins.

name: Temple of the Sun
description: Activate powerful abilities that improve speed, damage, range, or regeneration of specific units.

name: The White Stupa
description:
Acts as an Ovoo and produces 240 Stone per minute without a Stone Outcropping.
Decreases the Stone cost of double unit production by -50%.

name: Wynguard Palace
description: Allows production of 4 battalions: Wynguard Army, Wynguard Rangers, Wynguard Raiders, and Wynguard Footmen.

name: Zhu Xi's Library
description:
Hosts a range of highly unique upgrades.
Can unlock Yuan Raiders and Imperial Guards. Only 2 technologies can be researched.

name: Azure Mosque
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Castle
description: Heavy garrison and defensible position equipped with a powerful Rocket, which deals high damage to a single target. Can be upgraded with weaponry. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.

name: Cathedral of Divine Wisdom
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Cathedral of St. Thomas
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Cathedral of the Tsar
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Enclave of the Emperor
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Great Mosque
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Great Palace of Agra
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Great Palace of Flensburg
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Madrasa
description: Houses advanced technology that benefit the civilization.

name: Monument of the Great Khan
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Notre Dame
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Prayer Hall of Uqba
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: Tokugawa Shrine
description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

name: University
description: Houses advanced technology that benefit the civilization.

name: Champion Companions
description:
Level 3 option

Jeanne's Champions become available to train at Barracks.
Gains "To Arms, Men!", which rallies 3 Champions to her side.

Requires 500XP

name: Field Commander
description:
Level 4 option

Jeanne's Rally Call ability will now call 7 of her chosen companions onto the Battlefield.
Gains the Strength of Heaven ultimate ability, which greatly empowers a single unit.

Requires 500XP

name: Gunpowder Monarch
description:
Level 4 option

Jeanne's Rally Call ability will now call 3 of her chosen companions and a powerful Cannon onto the Battlefield.
Gains the Valorous Inspiration ultimate ability, which greatly increases the attack speed of nearby allies.

Requires 500XP

name: Path of the Archer
description:
Level 2 option

Jeanne chooses the path of the Archer, equipping a bow to engage foes from afar.
Gains the Divine Arrow ability, which deals high damage to a single target.

Requires 500XP

name: Path of the Warrior
description:
Level 2 option

Jeanne chooses the path of the Warrior, equipping a two handed sword to engage foes in close combat.
Gains the Holy Wrath ability, which deals area of effect damage around Jeanne.

Requires 500XP

name: Rider Companions
description:
Level 3 option

Jeanne's Riders become available to train at Stables.
Gains "Riders, Ready!", which rallies 3 Riders to her side.

Requires 500XP

name: Advanced Academy
description: Increases military production speed by +25% and outfits Military Schools with the ability to train Lancers and Janissaries.

name:
Advancement
(Feudal Culture Wing)
description:

description: With new gunpowder, Handcannoneers gain +5 damage against melee infantry and gain a brief increase to their movement speed after firing their weapon.

name: Sharpening Stones (5/6)
description:
Increase the ranged damage of all arrows and bolts by +1.

Can be researched twice in Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age, for a total of 6 times.

name: Sharpening Stones (6/6)
description:
Increase the ranged damage of all arrows and bolts by +1.

Can be researched twice in Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age, for a total of 6 times.

name: Shattering Projectiles
description: Trebuchet projectiles shatter on impact, increasing their area of effect.

name: Ships of the Crown
description: Investing in bigger and better ship hulls increases Carrack damage by 20%, health by 15%, and range by 10%.

name: Shipwrights
description: Increase the health of all military ships by +20% and ranged armor by +1.

name: Siege Crew Training
description: Setup and teardown speed of Mangonels, Trebuchets, and Bombards is instant.

name: Siege Works
description: New carpentry techniques increase the health of siege units by +20%.

name: Siege Works (Improved)
description:
New carpentry techniques increase the health of siege engines by +30%.
If Siege Works has already been researched, increase their health by +10% instead.

name: Siha Bow Limbs
description: Increase the ranged damage of Mangudai and the Khan by +1.

name: Siha Bow Limbs (Improved)
description:
Increase the ranged damage of Mangudai and the Khan by +2.
If Siha Bow Limbs has already been researched, increase the ranged damage of Mangudai and the Khan by +1.

name: Silk Bowstrings
description: Stringing bows with silk grants Archers +1 range and Mounted Archers +0.5 range.

name: Spice Roads
description: Increase the Gold income from Traders and Trade Ships by +30%.

name: Spyglass
description: Increase the sight radius of Scouts by 30%.

name: Steppe Lancers (Improved)
description:
Increase Keshik healing by +2 Health per attack and attack speed by +20%.
If Steppe Lancers has already been researched, increase Keshik healing by +1 Health per attack and attack speed by +10%.

name: Stone Bounty
description: Add +50 Stone to the raid income for igniting a building.

name: Stone Bounty (Improved)
description:
Add +75 Stone to the raid income for igniting a building.
If Stone Bounty has already been researched, add +25 Stone to the raid income for igniting a building.

name: Stone Commerce
description: Traders supply +10% Stone to their trades.

name: Stone Commerce (Improved)
description:
Traders supply +20% Stone to their trades.
If Stone Commerce has already been researched, supply +10% Stone instead.

name: Swivel Cannon
description: Springald Ships gain an additional Cannon which fires in 360 degrees.

name: Throwing Dagger Drills
description:
Earl's Guards are supplied with additional Daggers when throwing, these Daggers also deal a small amount of area damage.
Earl's Guards now throw 2 Daggers but are less accurate.

name: Thunderclap Bombs
description: Warships fire a Nest of Bees attack.

name: Tithe Barns
description: Relics placed in a Mosque provide an income of +40 Food, +40 Wood, and +10 Stone every minute.

name: Tithe Barns (Improved)
description:
Relics placed in a Prayer Tent provide an income of +60 Food, +60 Wood, and +15 Stone every minute.
If Tithe Barns has already been researched, increase the income of Food and Wood by +20 and Stone by +5 instead.

name: Tower Shields
description: Equipping tall tower shields grants Men-at-Arms +3 ranged armor.

name: Trebuchet Emplacement
description: Add a defensive trebuchet emplacement to this structure.

name: War Horses

name: Yaki-ire
description: Increase the melee damage of all non-siege units by +1.

name: Yam Network (Improved)
description:
Yam speed aura applies to all units instead of just Traders and cavalry units. Does not apply to siege engines.
Improved Yam Network allows Traders to regenerate 1 health every 2 seconds while in Yam's aura.
